notes: phase6-scope.md State 2, second bullet (line 59): the resolved active slot can itself be fresh/archive-less -- createFreshWorldSlot's no-backing-archive case (fresh-archive-less-slot-creation.json). There is no live data to materialize, so Phase 6 leaves no live folders on disk; the server generates a new world on first start, identical to MSC 1's own behavior when a not-yet-activated fresh slot is later activated (the willGenerateFresh branch, WorldSlotManager.swift line 667/759-766). The active marker is still persisted regardless, so activation state is well-defined before any Phase 6 route becomes reachable for this server -- this is the one branch where the marker is written even though nothing else changed on disk.
